nodes.name: PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE
nodes.summary: Standard PR template for the Understand-Anything plugin project
nodes.description: GitHub pull request template that enforces structured PR descriptions including summary, linked issues, testing steps, and version bumping requirements for user-facing changes.

nodes.name: Debug AndroidManifest
nodes.summary: Debug build manifest granting internet permission for Flutter development
nodes.description: Android manifest for debug builds that grants INTERNET permission, required for Flutter tool communication, breakpoints, and hot reload functionality.

nodes.name: Main AndroidManifest
nodes.summary: Primary Android manifest defining PoolOS app entry point and permissions
nodes.description: Main Android manifest for PoolOS V2 app. Defines MainActivity with launchMode singleTop, theme LaunchTheme, and hardware acceleration. Includes intent filters for MAIN/LAUNCHER and PROCESS_TEXT for text input handling.

nodes.name: Launch Background (v21+)
nodes.summary: Splash screen background for Android 5.0+ devices with dark mode support
nodes.description: Android 5.0+ splash screen drawable that uses system background color. Supports dark mode via ?android:colorBackground theme attribute.

nodes.name: Launch Background (Legacy)
nodes.summary: Splash screen background using solid white for legacy Android versions
nodes.description: Legacy Android splash screen drawable with solid white background. Used for devices below Android 5.0.

nodes.name: Night Styles
nodes.summary: Android theme styles for dark mode (night) configuration
nodes.description: Dark mode theme definitions with LaunchTheme using Theme.Black.NoTitleBar and NormalTheme with system background. Referenced by launch_background drawable.

nodes.name: Default Styles
nodes.summary: Android theme styles for light mode (default) configuration
nodes.description: Light mode theme definitions with LaunchTheme using Theme.Light.NoTitleBar and NormalTheme with system background. Uses launch_background drawable for splash.

nodes.name: Profile AndroidManifest
nodes.summary: Profile build manifest granting internet permission for performance profiling
nodes.description: Android manifest for profile builds that grants INTERNET permission, used when running with --profile flag for performance analysis.

nodes.name: FlutterGeneratedPluginSwiftPackage
nodes.summary: Swift Package Manager manifest for Flutter-generated plugins
nodes.description: Auto-generated Swift Package Manager configuration for Flutter plugins. Defines a static library target named FlutterGeneratedPluginSwiftPackage with iOS 13.0 minimum deployment target.

nodes.name: FlutterGeneratedPluginSwiftPackage Source
nodes.summary: Placeholder source file for generated plugin package
nodes.description: Auto-generated placeholder file indicating this is a generated package. Plugins are registered via GeneratedPluginRegistrant in AppDelegate.

nodes.name: AppDelegate
nodes.summary: iOS app delegate handling Flutter engine initialization and plugin registration
nodes.description: Main iOS application delegate extending FlutterAppDelegate with FlutterImplicitEngineDelegate. Handles Flutter engine initialization via didInitializeImplicitFlutterEngine and registers all plugins via GeneratedPluginRegistrant.

nodes.name: App Icon Assets
nodes.summary: Asset catalog configuration for iOS app icons across all device sizes
nodes.description: Asset catalog Contents.json defining app icon sizes for iPhone (20pt to 60pt in 1x/2x/3x), iPad (20pt to 83.5pt), and iOS marketing (1024pt).

nodes.name: Launch Image Assets
nodes.summary: Asset catalog configuration for iOS launch/splash images
nodes.description: Asset catalog Contents.json defining launch images at universal scale for 1x/2x/3x resolutions. Displays during app startup before Flutter renders.

nodes.name: SceneDelegate
nodes.summary: iOS scene delegate for managing app windows and lifecycle
nodes.description: Scene delegate extending FlutterSceneDelegate for managing app window lifecycle and scene configuration. Handles scene creation and configuration events.

nodes.name: RunnerTests
nodes.summary: XCTest test case for iOS Runner application
nodes.description: XCTest test case for iOS Runner application. Contains template testExample method for adding application tests. References Flutter and XCTest frameworks.

nodes.name: Drill to Knowledge Mapping
nodes.summary: Maps pool drill codes to required knowledge article IDs
nodes.description: Maps drill codes (STOP_LV1-LV3, DRAW_LV1-LV3, etc.) to required knowledge article IDs (kn_stop-shot, kn_draw-shot, etc.). Used to determine which knowledge articles players must study before attempting drills.

nodes.name: Knowledge Search Index
nodes.summary: Full-text search index for pool knowledge articles with Vietnamese support
nodes.description: Comprehensive search index for PoolOS knowledge library. Contains knowledge articles (kn_stop-shot, kn_draw-shot, etc.) with titles in English and Vietnamese, aliases for natural language search, and keywords for semantic matching.

nodes.name: V1 Knowledge Migration
nodes.summary: Migration record for knowledge articles imported from V1
nodes.description: Migration metadata recording import of 9 knowledge articles from V1 Knowledge Library on 2026-08-02. Status marked as completed.

nodes.name: AppConstants
nodes.summary: Core application constants including player levels, rating system, and assessment questions
nodes.description: Defines PoolOS core constants: app info (name, version), player levels K/pro with Hanoi standard ratings, Pool Rating system (0-1000 scale with 5 skill groups), assessment questions for initial skill evaluation, session types, shot types, and coach recommendation priorities.

nodes.name: Constants Barrel
nodes.summary: Barrel export file for all core constants
nodes.description: Barrel export file re-exporting app_constants.dart and supabase_config.dart. Provides single import point for all constants.

nodes.name: SupabaseConfig
nodes.summary: Backend-as-a-service configuration for Supabase database
nodes.description: Supabase configuration containing placeholder URL and anon key. Includes local development option for localhost:54321.

nodes.name: Certification Models
nodes.summary: Skill certification system with test suites and pass/fail criteria
nodes.description: Defines SkillCertification, CertificationTest, CertificationResult, and CertificationLibrary. Includes certifications for Stop Shot, Draw Shot, Follow Shot, Bank Shot, and Position Control with difficulty levels (easy/medium/hard) and pass rate requirements.

nodes.name: DrillProgress Models
nodes.summary: Tracks user progress through drill levels with unlock mechanics
nodes.description: DrillProgress tracks player progress with currentLevel, bestScore, totalAttempts, totalSuccesses. DrillLevelAttempt records individual attempts. Includes isLevelUnlocked and isLevelPassed logic for progressive unlocking.

nodes.name: Knowledge Models
nodes.summary: Pool skill knowledge library with articles and categories
nodes.description: KnowledgeArticle and KnowledgeLibrary defining static knowledge base. Contains categories: Cue Ball Control (stop/draw/follow), Aiming (ghost ball, cut shots), Safety, Bridge (open/closed), Strategy (position play). Supports search and category filtering.

nodes.name: Match Models
nodes.summary: Match recording with rack-by-rack statistics tracking
nodes.description: Match and Rack models for recording pool matches. Match includes opponent, raceTo, result, racks list. Rack tracks break success, longest run, fouls, safety plays, confidence rating. MatchStats aggregates statistics from rack list.

edges.description: MainActivity references LaunchTheme and NormalTheme styles
MainActivity theme adapts to night mode via style resolution
Night LaunchTheme uses v21 launch_background drawable
Both are build variant manifests with identical INTERNET permission
Debug manifest extends main manifest for debug build
SceneDelegate works with AppDelegate for window management
Drill mapping references knowledge article IDs from search index
Migration record documents articles imported into search index
Certification tests reference knowledge articles for study materials
Drill progress tracks drill codes that map to knowledge articles
Match models use constants for session types and shot types
Certification uses priority constants for recommendations
Both are asset catalog Contents.json files in Assets.xcassets
Package.swift defines the Swift package target
v21 version adds dark mode support, fallback uses solid color
